author: CBR
description:
Jessica Jones is back in the Daredevil universe, and this clip gets into the real question: does her return mean Luke Cage and the Defenders are next? We talk about why the Jessica Jones/Luke Cage dynamic still has unfinished business, why Iron Fist feels “dated,” and whether Marvel should bring that character back at all. If Daredevil: Born Again Season 2 is “collecting Defenders,” this is the exact kind of street-level MCU setup fans have been waiting for.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 16.
